text: Remember that an `async def` function is a coroutine. To run it, you cannot just call `run_cylinder(1)`. You need an event loop, usually started via `asyncio.run(main())`.
Never use the standard `time.sleep()` in an async function. It is a 'blocking' call and will freeze the entire event loop. Always use `await asyncio.sleep()`.
`asyncio.gather(coro1(), coro2(), ...)` takes multiple coroutines and schedules them to run concurrently on the event loop.
To offset the cylinders (firing order), you can await a small `asyncio.sleep()` at the very beginning of the `run_cylinder` function based on the cylinder's ID before starting the 4-stroke loop.
